semiconductor_relevance: High — Eport Co., Ltd. specializes in thermally conductive materials essential for semiconductor packaging, particularly in advanced applications.
summary: Eport Co., Ltd. manufactures and supplies advanced thermally conductive materials, specifically spherical alumina and silicon nitride, for use in thermal interface materials within the semiconductor industry. The company leverages its proprietary technology to develop high-purity materials that enhance heat dissipation in cutting-edge semiconductor packaging solutions.
capabilities: Manufacturing of thermally conductive spherical alumina
Development of high-purity spherical alumina using proprietary synthesis technology
Production of ceramic fillers for thermal interface materials
Optimized fillers for advanced semiconductor packaging materials (EMC)

regional_presence.Korea: Eport Co., Ltd. is a leading thermal conductive material company based in South Korea, focusing on the semiconductor industry.
